<module id="multi_pipe_8bit">
    <description>Unsigned 8-bit multiplier using pipelining.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for chip reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="mul_en_in">Input enable signal that controls the multiplication operation.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[7:0]">Input signal representing the multiplicand with a data width of 8 bits.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[7:0]">Input signal representing the multiplier with a data width of 8 bits.</input>
        <output id="mul_en_out">Output enable signal indicating if the multiplication operation is enabled.</output>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[15:0]">Product output signal with a data width of 16 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH" value="8">Width of the multiplicand and multiplier.</parameter>
        <parameter id="PRODUCT_WIDTH" value="16">Width of the product.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <reg id="mul_en_out_reg" type="sequential_logic">Register to hold the input enable signal.</reg>
        <reg id="mul_a_reg" type="sequential_logic">Register to hold the multiplicand.</reg>
        <reg id="mul_b_reg" type="sequential_logic">Register to hold the multiplier.</reg>
        <wire id="temp" width="16" type="combinational_logic">Wires to hold partial products.</wire>
        <reg id="sum" width="16" type="sequential_logic">Registers to hold intermediate sum values.</reg>
        <reg id="mul_out_reg" width="16" type="sequential_logic">Register to hold the final product.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                mul_en_out_reg <= 1'b0;
                mul_a_reg <= 8'b0;
                mul_b_reg <= 8'b0;
                sum <= {16{1'b0}};
                mul_out_reg <= {16{1'b0}};
            end else begin
                mul_en_out_reg <= mul_en_in;
                if (mul_en_in) begin
                    mul_a_reg <= mul_a;
                    mul_b_reg <= mul_b;
                end
            end
        end

        always @(posedge clk) begin
            if (mul_en_in) begin
                for (int i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin
                    temp[i] = mul_a_reg & (mul_b_reg >> i);
                end
                sum[0] <= temp[0];
                for (int j = 1; j < WIDTH; j = j + 1) begin
                    sum[j] <= sum[j - 1] + temp[j];
                end
                mul_out_reg <= sum[WIDTH - 1];
            end
        end

        always @(posedge clk) begin
            if (mul_en_out_reg) begin
                mul_out <= mul_out_reg;
            end else begin
                mul_out <= {16{1'b0}};
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
